data.narrative:
Aalo Atomics, a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Matt Loszak, has raised $136M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a broader comp universe of 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, and Antares operating in the same sector.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using total raised ($136M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $258M. A peer-median approach was not viable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables in the nuclear energy subsector—while 4 same-sector peers exist, none satisfied the threshold of 3+ datapoints within tight valuation or stage filters, making sector-wide medians unreliable as anchors.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $220M (low) to $297M (high), with a median of $258M. This range reflects conservative application of stage-based progression mechanics against the $136M capital base. Key uncertainties include the lack of direct peer multiples at identical stage and capitalization; reliance on a single applicable method limits cross-validation. Near-term clarity would benefit from establishing meaningful comparable transactions or financings in the frontier nuclear subsector.
